occurrences.trigger: NpgsqlException is the first observed physical open failure
occurrences.semantics: The first open failure remains authoritative through cleanup.
occurrences.evidence_required: primary failure code, exception chain, transitions, cleanup result

occurrences.trigger: cleanup throws and no primary failure exists
occurrences.semantics: Cleanup becomes terminal only when there is no primary failure to preserve.
occurrences.evidence_required: cleanup exception, before/after connection state, lifecycle transitions

occurrences.trigger: concurrent open/peer failure handling cannot rethrow the captured first failure
occurrences.semantics: The run stops because primary failure authority cannot be proven.
occurrences.evidence_required: both observed tasks, captured primary, settlement and transitions

occurrences.trigger: cleanup fails after an earlier primary failure
occurrences.semantics: Cleanup is retained but never replaces the first failure.
occurrences.evidence_required: primary failure plus suppressed cleanup failure

occurrences.trigger: cleanup result records failure without a captured primary
occurrences.semantics: The cleanup result is terminal because no prior failure exists.
occurrences.evidence_required: cleanup failure type and lifecycle state

occurrences.semantics: Lifecycle transition only; the associated primary failure code decides the operator action.
occurrences.evidence_required: transition sequence and primary failure code

occurrences.trigger: a stack frame has no declaring type
occurrences.semantics: Placeholder only; it carries no economic or lifecycle decision.
occurrences.evidence_required: enclosing failure evidence and sanitized frame

occurrences.trigger: a stack frame has no method name
occurrences.semantics: Placeholder only; it carries no economic or lifecycle decision.
occurrences.evidence_required: enclosing failure evidence and sanitized frame

occurrences.trigger: session cleanup fails after primary or primary-open failure
occurrences.semantics: The second source occurrence preserves the same suppression contract.
occurrences.evidence_required: primary failure, cleanup exception and final connection state
